evidence: On the regular degree-matched protocol ontology is nearly flat: base + ontology 0.2913 / 0.2905 against base 0.2894 / 0.2866, although MRR rises from 0.541 to 0.570.
observation: The same ontology features that help cold diseases add almost nothing when the disease already has training edges: base plus ontology is 0.2913 macro versus 0.2894, while MRR improves. The value of ontology is therefore concentrated in cold diseases and explanation, not in adding terms to the core.
subject: F-63
title: Ancestor-closed HPO is nearly flat on the regular degree-matched protocol
